kurgu-zanaati.disinda: audio mixing/mastering details (ses-tasarimi), motion graphics/animation from scratch (hareket-tasarimi), image generation (gorsel-uretim), platform export presets/QC thresholds (teslim-denetimi)

kurgu-zanaati.ek:
- EDIT PLAN CONTRACT (authoritative; medya senkron, medya denetle and medya nle already read it — document it in references/plan-semasi.md and make plan_denetle.py (if kept) enforce exactly this): plan/kurgu.json = {ad?, fps, boyut: [w, h], sure?, muzik?: {dosya, bas (seconds into the music file that align with t=0), analiz? (path to medya muzik JSON)}, cekimler: [{no, kaynak (read-only original under kaynak/), kaynak_bas, klip? (prepared intermediate under calisma/klipler/: sdr/cfr/yavaslat output; absent → the original is used), klip_bas?, cikti_bas, cikti_son (output seconds on the k/fps grid), hiz (speed vs the original; < 1 MUST be baked into klip with medya yavaslat, then klip plays 1:1), ses: kendi|muzik|sessiz (kendi = camera audio from kaynak, only at hiz 1), vurusa: true|false (explicit; measured by medya senkron), gecis: {tur: kesim|erime|j-kesim|l-kesim|eslesme|savurma|yakinlasma|isik|siyah-dip|beyaz-dip|flas, sure_kare} = transition INTO this shot; erime is an overlap: cikti_bas = previous cikti_son − sure_kare/fps; kadraj?, hareket? (reframe / punch-in / Ken Burns parameters for the composition)}]}. Paths are relative to the project root (run medya commands from the project root) or absolute.
- medya nle <plan> --bicim otio|edl|hepsi → cikti/nle/: tested: overlap dissolves become cut + centered SMPTE dissolve with handles, source frames and total duration preserved, music on A1 (from muzik.bas), camera sound (ses: kendi) on A2+, downbeat markers from the music JSON; kadraj/hareket/non-dissolve transitions/unbaked speed become red markers + clip metadata. FCPXML was dropped: otio-fcpx-xml-adapter 1.0.0 lost dissolves and inserted a gap on read-back (10 s → 12 s). Resolve/Kdenlive import itself could NOT be tested (not installed).
- medya muzik committee on ground-truth tracks: steady drums & a 84→96 BPM drifting live tempo → 'yuksek' with every beat within ≤40 ms (p90 ≤ 30 ms); hi-hat-heavy metrical ambiguity and a drumless soft pad song → NOT 'yuksek' (honest). A fixed BPM grid drifted 1610 ms on the drifting track.
- Cut-frame rounding for beat cuts: picture slightly early is safer than late (ITU-R BT.1359: audio-early detectable at 45 ms, late at 125 ms): cut_frame = floor(beat*fps). medya senkron accepts p90 ≤ 40 ms and max ≤ 70 ms.
- Slow motion (ground truth from real high-fps footage, frames decoded directly): Apple FRC ≈ minterpolate in quality (43.2 vs 42.9 dB mean; worst 41.3 vs 41.7), Apple ~3x faster; frame blending clearly worse (worst 32.3 dB, ghosting). Measurement 2 (only synthesized frames, decoded directly): Apple ≈ RIFE v4.6 > minterpolate (1.5–2 dB on high motion; handheld real camera 24 fps ×2: RIFE 37.7 vs minterpolate 32.6); calm footage: no difference. RIFE is now the first fallback. The skill must call 'medya yavaslat' (the capability), never a specific engine; real high-fps sources ('dogal') stay best. ffmpeg's psnr filter misaligns frames when timestamps differ — decode frames directly for comparisons.
- HyperFrames: data-playback-rate < 1 duplicates frames (pre-render slow-mo); video times are quantized to frames (snap every time to k/fps or picture lags audio up to 1 frame). FINAL renders with real footage: --video-frame-format png (JPEG intermediates VMAF 95.0, PNG 96.6; ~2x render time); drafts may use the default. Default quality CRF 16 is huge for long grainy video → --video-bitrate.
- Audit lessons: a 1-frame black/flash frame is replaced with a copy of the previous frame, never deleted (deleting shifts every later cut by one frame); finishing order: picture fixes → audio defect repair → medya ustala → medya meta-temizle LAST → medya denetle.
- medya zamankodu makes a 720 px review draft with 'dk:sn.kare' burned in so the user can give timed feedback (never a deliverable).

Turkish (license-checked, on demand), music generation options that are commercial-safe and feasible on M2 16GB (on demand), what to avoid (MusicGen CC-BY-NC, Stable Audio Open license limits, XTTS NC...), verification by measurement (ebur128, true peak, spectrogram PNG, medya ses-olay, medya yaziya-dok intelligibility).
ses-tasarimi.disinda: picture editing (kurgu-zanaati), motion graphics (hareket-tasarimi), images (gorsel-uretim), final QC thresholds and export presets (teslim-denetimi)
ses-tasarimi.senaryo: Videodaki konuşmayı temizle (arkada rüzgâr ve kalabalık var), altına telifsiz bir fon müziği koy, konuşurken müziği kıs, geçişlere ince efektler ekle, sonunda Instagram'a uygun ses seviyesi olsun. Bir de Türkçe kısa bir dış ses lazım.
ses-tasarimi.degisken: Şarkı 3 dakika ama video 75 saniye: şarkıyı videoya uydur, son bölümü güzel bitsin; sözlerin en duygusal yeri videonun doruğuna gelsin.
ses-tasarimi.ek:
- medya ustala: alimiter latency=1 → output 0.000 ms offset vs input (the default limiter delayed ~4 ms). Never overwrites the input; video stream copied.
- medya ayir (htdemucs): > 45 dB speech/music separation in the vocals stem in a test (9 s clip).
- medya yaziya-dok: Turkish exact on a test sentence (it writes 'dokuzda' as '9'da'); --sarki for lyrics on a vocals stem; condition_on_previous_text=False already set.
- medya ses-temizle (DeepFilterNet3 binary 0.5.6): always '-D' (delay compensation; without it the output is 30 ms late) and an attenuation limit of 12 dB by default (--siddet). Measured on a noisy Turkish speech fixture: unlimited suppression removed the most noise but Whisper intelligibility fell 12/15 → 10/15; the 12 dB limit raised SI-SDR 1.8 → 10.1 dB AND intelligibility to 13/15. '--dogrula' compares Whisper transcripts before/after. It can remux cleaned audio into a video.
- medya ses-olay (Apple SoundAnalysis): laughter/applause/speech/singing/music time ranges.
- medya denetle flags clicks at cuts (isolated-spike test; hi-hats don't trigger) and clipping.
- Audit lesson (2026-10-05, defect fixture): a 0.5 ms full-scale impulse at a cut gave +1.8 dBTP and 40 clipped samples. Repair clicks BEFORE medya ustala (regenerate the audio or interpolate the 0.5 ms linearly). Do NOT leave it to the limiter: it would press the click only ~4.7 dB, it stays audible and causes a gain dip. A crossfade does not help when there is no audio seam.
- Finishing order: picture fixes → click/defect repair → medya ustala → medya meta-temizle LAST (ustala's remux keeps GPS location tags) → medya denetle --hedef ...
- Installed in ortamlar/ses: pedalboard 0.9.25 (GPL-3), librosa, demucs, mlx-whisper, essentia (AGPL), mir_eval. Not installed: TTS engines, music generators. macOS 'say -v Yelda' (Turkish system voice) exists and is used for test fixtures; the license of its output for public/commercial use is NOT verified — personal drafts only.
- HyperFrames audio: static <audio> elements with data-* timing; volume automation lanes for ducking (vendor skill hyperframes-audio).

gorsel-uretim.ek:
- medya arkaplan-sil <resim> [--maske] [--kirp] [--cikti x.png]: Apple Vision foreground instance mask → transparent PNG (offline, no download; macOS system framework). Quality on hair/fine edges is NOT yet measured against rembg/BiRefNet — inspect on black/white/checker backgrounds before claiming.
- medya meta-temizle uses ExifTool 13.59 for images: '-all= -tagsFromFile @ -Orientation -ICC_Profile -ColorSpaceTags' (lossless; keeps orientation and color profile; verified pixel-identical in a test).
- Apple VTSuperResolution was TESTED AND REJECTED for stills: only 4x, darkened shadows, PSNR worse than bicubic, and it writes alpha 0 (PNG turned white). The subcommand was removed from medya-apple. Do not propose Apple super-resolution again; candidates are Real-ESRGAN ncnn (check code and weights licenses) or Lanczos.
- medya analiz <video|resim>: per-frame aesthetics score (-1..1), faces + capture quality, saliency box, labels — use it to pick cover/thumbnail frames and subject centers for crops.
- medya kontak is for VIDEO only. There is no medya command for still-image contact sheets yet.
- Pillow is in .venv; ImageMagick is NOT available (no Homebrew); macOS 'sips' exists.
- Not installed (on demand; ask before > 2 GB): mflux + FLUX.2 [klein] 4B (Apache-2.0, ~4.3 GB Q4), rembg/BiRefNet, Real-ESRGAN ncnn, LaMa ONNX, rawpy, vtracer, Depth Anything V2 Small. Paid cloud generators (Higgsfield, Midjourney, Runway…) are not used.

teslim-denetimi.ek:
- medya denetle validated on fixtures: catches a 1-frame black flash (8.0 s), a click at a cut (isolated-spike test; hi-hats don't trigger), GPS tags, loudness/true peak, clipping; a clean file passes. Flash detection uses per-frame histogram distance (ffmpeg's scene score cannot see flashes). Missing faststart (moov at the end) FAILS for --hedef web/sosyal/youtube; missing color tags → warning.
- The 3-lens audit workflow (medya-denetim) on the defect fixture returned KALDI and found every planted defect. Its fix plan (authoritative): replace a 1-frame flash with a copy of the previous frame (do not delete it: that shifts every later cut by one frame); repair clicks before ustala; run medya ustala; run medya meta-temizle LAST (ustala's remux keeps the udta/loci GPS atom; meta-temizle strips it and moves moov to the front = faststart); then medya denetle --hedef ...

FINAL renders with real footage: --video-frame-format png (JPEG intermediates VMAF 95.0, PNG 96.6, ffmpeg direct 96.8; worst frame 94.4 → 95.7; ~2x render time). Drafts may use the default.

- medya sdr default tonemap is mobius (HLG/PQ → bt709); medya cfr for VFR; medya incele reports HDR/VFR/rotation/10-bit/GPS.
